metadata.title: Preliminary Summary of Harmonic Readout and c=1 Area Sweep in an AB Two-Body Closed Phase System
metadata.description: This V4 release keeps the AB two-body harmonic readout and c=1 area sweep claims unchanged while replacing the previous recoil-factor implementation with a direct A/B two-channel scattering-matrix action on the incident channels. The result confirms that the acceleration-like harmonic readout and chi-tau area readout remain evaluable, and that label-free D_AB and V_AB remain degenerate with the transmission-type readout in the AB two-body closed phase system. The paper still does not claim a native inverse-area, inverse-law, or inverse-square-law derivation.
metadata.notes: This V4 update keeps the AB two-body acceleration-readout claims unchanged. It replaces the previous q_out_factor operator treatment with direct A/B two-channel scattering and re-reads chi_read and eta_read from the outgoing channel difference.
